proposal.blind_spot: Current metrics show resident warps failing to issue but cannot distinguish whether they stall on global-memory load latency (long scoreboard) or on block barriers from Triton's cross-warp reduction steps, which require opposite fixes.

rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> increase memory-level parallelism: larger per-thread tiles, unroll the reduction loop, vectorize/widen coalesced loads, prefetch ahead of dependent loads / LOW -> abandon load-latency fixes and target synchronization or dependency chains instead
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_barrier_per_war: HIGH -> replace shared-memory plus syncthreads combines with warp-shuffle reductions, give each block more independent work, reduce barrier rounds per tile / LOW -> keep the block-reduction structure and look to memory latency or excess work
